text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Critical - realtime: model-runner-prod - 500/503 spike >15% over 5m. Alert threshold triggered.

alex: i'm on it, looking at gpu-03 and autoscaler panels
maria: noticed several OOM kills on gpu-03 around 10:11 UTC, PID 2312
jin: logs look like segfault coming from compiled kernel during KV cache write
alex: stack snippet from dmesg:
```
[10:11:22] model_runner[2312]: segfault at 0 ip=0x7f1a2b... sp=0x7ffdf... error=4 in libllm_kern.so
[10:11:22] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 2312 (model_runner) score 123 or sacrifice child
[10:11:23] systemd: model-runner.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL
```

samir: count of 5xx is concentrated on route /v1/generate-heavy, P95 latency up from 120ms to 870ms
ellie: customers affected: 'edge-search' (prod tenant), 'writerly' reported 502s. estimated 12% of requests failing
alex: mitigation plan: 1) remove heavy batching (set batch_max_tokens=256 -> 64) 2) drain traffic from gpu-03 3) fallback to smaller model variant 'redwood-medium-v1' for canary customers
maria: set systemctl restart model-runner on gpu-03 didn't bring it back, core dumped immediately on start
jin: reproducing locally with same model and kv-cache size - hitting segfault with kv-cache>1.2GB
samir: temporary routing change: ops-bot, can we add autoscale rule to spin up extra nodes and route traffic away from gpu-03?
ops-bot: Executing: scale up model-runner-prod by +2 instances (gpu type) — ETA ~45s
alex: switching route for tenant edge-search to dedicated fallback pool (edge-search-fallback)
ellie: sending customer comms draft to cs: "We are investigating elevated error rates..." :email:

maria: root cause hypothesis: memory regression after kernel optimization merged yesterday (PR 5123) causing excessive KV cache growth and native segfaults
jin: rollback candidate: revert PR 5123 on runtime branch, but that requires full build and validation (30-45m)
alex: short-term: disable KV caching feature flag for prod to avoid segfaults
samir: i pushed a flag toggle: `kv_cache.enabled=false` to prod config via ssm
ops-bot: Config updated: kv_cache.enabled=false on model-runner-prod (change id cfg-20260315-01)

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Auto-sla: 60s paging window closed; critical remains open
alex: handoff in 10m — @maria will take primary if i need break
maria: taking over. current state: traffic rerouted, extra instances booting, kv cache disabled. monitoring 5xx rates

jin: spike dropping: 5xx now 4.2% -> good sign
ellie: update sent to customers at 10:32 UTC
alex: note for postmortem: include kernel/allocator metrics, relevant PR 5123, can we add more graceful degradation when native lib crashes?
maria: agreed, will open postmortem ticket and assign action items
samir: final note: we should add preflight test for KV-cache size on model variants during CI

maria: handing off to @jin for overnight watch. leaving logs/diagnostics pinned in #eng-runtime
jin: ack, i'll keep an eye and start roll back if we see recurrence
